title: Q-MAWS: Quartet-based phylogeny from Minimal Absent Word Sets
description: Q-MAWS estimates a species tree from whole genomes without sequence alignment. It counts binary column patterns for every four-taxon subset of a minimal absent word character matrix, weights the three quartet topologies with a conditioned two-state likelihood, and combines the weighted quartets into one tree with a re-implementation of the wQFM algorithm. Every run keeps a complete record, so its results can be recomputed and verified.
